overview.description: Century Spice Road is a commercial card-driven strategy game where players trade and upgrade spice cubes to buy point cards.
overview.deck: Dedicated merchant and point cards plus spice cubes

history.origins: Designed by Emerson Matsuuchi and published by Plan B Games in 2017, Century Spice Road uses cards to model fifteenth-century spice trading and engine building.

rules.objective: Score the most points by acquiring point cards through spice conversion and trading.
rules.gameplay: Players play merchant cards to gain, trade, or upgrade spices; rest to recover played cards; or spend spices to claim point cards.
keyRules: Spice cubes are upgraded and traded.
Point cards are bought with spice sets.
